What have you tried? What happened?
Why does my sourdough collapse in the oven?
It rises beautifully overnight, but the moment it hits the oven it spreads into a pancake. 75% hydration, 20% starter.
Sounds over-proofed. At 75% hydration, try a shorter bulk — stop at about 50% rise, not double — and shape tighter.
Also check your starter: if it peaks in 3 hours, use it at peak, not after it falls.
How do I centre a div vertically in 2026?
I keep finding answers from 2014. What is the simplest modern way?
Make the parent `display: grid` and add `place-items: center`. Two lines, works everywhere.
Is it worth learning Rust as a first language?
I mostly want to build command line tools. Friends say start with Python.
If CLIs are the goal, Rust is a great fit — but expect a steeper first month. Python gets you shipping faster.
What's the best way to keep basil alive indoors?
Every supermarket basil plant I buy dies within two weeks.
How do I explain a two-year career gap in an interview?
I took time off to care for a parent. I'm worried it looks bad.
Say it plainly and briefly: you were caring for family, it's resolved, and here's what you kept sharp. Then move on. Most interviewers respect it.
Why is my CSS grid overflowing on phones?
One column grows wider than the screen when it contains a long input.
Grid items default to `min-width: auto`. Use `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)` or give the child `min-width: 0`.
